items.title: Frank Goudie Interview
items.q: I think it was in the same outfit that Esham Joan was with.

ctx.x: Were you in Paris when Lizzie Miles was there? Yes. You were? Wasn't she called the Black Rose in Paris? Something like that.

I knew all those artists that came over. One is in, I can't remember their name, Elizabeth Wells. Did you do any blonde with, any groups with her? Well, in nightclubs I played with Elizabeth Wells. You never heard of Florence Mill? Yeah. Well, I met her too when she came to Europe. I think it was in the same outfit that Esham Joan was with. Johnny Dunn came over.
Johnny Dunn, there was that swinging cat. Yes.
